fields.description: Creek Haven is a waterfront apartment development in Dubai Creek Harbour, with one to three bedroom homes. The setting combines the creek promenade with landscaped spaces and a pool terrace. Tower A and Tower B have different layouts and outdoor areas; the size table keeps their plans separate so buyers can compare the actual home being offered.

reviewCoverage.identity: Official project page matched to existing Creek Haven ID. Tower B independently identified from its named plan pack and platform listing.
reviewCoverage.location: Dubai Creek Harbour and creek/park context verified in official brochure. Upcoming Blue Line identified as future infrastructure, not an operational station.
reviewCoverage.residences: One to three bedroom apartments; Tower A and B plans kept separate. No townhouse/penthouse inventory inferred from search category pages.
reviewCoverage.areas: 14-page official Tower A pack and 14-page third-party-hosted Emaar-branded Tower B pack fully extracted; total-area ranges calculated independently. Both massing pages visually reviewed.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project-specific brochure page 9 used; children’s pool supported by official page. Wider community schools/parks not claimed as completed on-site facilities.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Current developer units-from AED 2,722,888 used instead of earlier AED 1.86 million key fact. No availability count imported.
reviewCoverage.payment: Both Emaar-branded third-party-hosted sheets visually checked: 80/20 with different first four dated instalments. Bayut supports split; Property Finder also offers unconfirmed 10/90 alternative, explicitly flagged.
reviewCoverage.handover: Both copied schedules target March 2030, corroborated by both portals. Kept as a reported construction-completion target.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 22-page brochure, official Tower A plans, portal-hosted Tower B plans and two launch payment sheets read and attributed. Images unchanged.

overview: Creek Haven’s brochure combines gardens, shaded terraces and a waterfront promenade with spaces for exercise and family time. Warm natural colours are shown for the interiors. Creek, skyline and park outlooks vary by position; review the floor and orientation of an individual apartment rather than assuming every advertised view comes with every home.
research.locationNote: The official neighbourhood map places Creek Haven within Dubai Creek Harbour, around Creek Marina, the harbour promenade, Central Park and Creek Beach. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is part of the wider setting. The brochure describes the Metro Blue Line as upcoming infrastructure; it should not be treated as an operating transport connection.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays units from AED 2,722,888 and an earlier starting-price statement of AED 1.86 million. The current displayed unit figure is used here as a dated reference, without claiming an available allocation or particular floor.
research.paymentNote: Two third-party-hosted Emaar-branded launch sheets give the same 80/20 split but different early dates. The rows below distinguish the original release from Tower B where dates differ. Bayut supports 10/70/20; Property Finder additionally lists 10/90, which these documents do not establish. These historical schedules are not current booking terms.
research.handoverNote: Both copied launch schedules target March 2030 for estimated construction completion. Bayut and Property Finder also report Q1 2030. Obtain the current developer-issued programme and the contractual date for the chosen tower.
